info.title: ClubSphere API
info.description: University Club & Activity Lifecycle Management System — Backend REST APIs

get.description: Health and readiness probe for container orchestrators and smoke verification.

post.description: Register a new student user. Other roles are assigned by an Administrator.
Authenticate with email and password to receive JWT access and refresh tokens.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token and rotated refresh token.

get.description: Get the currently authenticated user's profile details.
List and search university clubs with department and status filters.

post.description: Directly create an active club (Administrator override; regular flow is via proposals).

get.description: Retrieve full details and statistics for a specific club.

put.description: Update club profile or status. Restricted to Club Manager of this club or Administrator.

post.description: Submit a membership request to join a club.

get.description: List members and applicants for a club. Restricted to Club Manager or Administrator.

put.description: Approve, reject, or update role of a club member. Restricted to Club Manager or Administrator.

get.description: List and filter university events with pagination and real-time seat availability.

post.description: Create a new event under the manager's club. Restricted to Club Manager or Administrator.

get.description: Retrieve event details, deadline, and live seat count.

put.description: Update event information or status. Restricted to event's club manager or administrator.

post.description: Register the current student for an event. Enforces capacity cap, deadline, and duplicate check.

delete.description: Cancel a student's confirmed registration for an event.

get.description: Retrieve full registrant roster with attendance flags. Restricted to event manager or admin.

post.description: Mark attendance for confirmed registered students. Rejects unconfirmed attendees.

get.description: Retrieve post-event outcome summary and verified attendance metrics.

post.description: Submit post-event summary report. Restricted to event manager or administrator.
Submit a new university club proposal for Faculty and HOD review.

get.description: List proposals accessible to the caller's role (Students see own; Reviewers see pending/all).
Retrieve full proposal record with recorded review decisions.

post.description:
Record a Faculty or HOD review decision. Final HOD approval activates the club automatically.

CRITICAL WORKFLOW & SECURITY RULES:
1. Students & Club Managers are strictly rejected with 403 Forbidden.
2. Faculty reviewer records stage='faculty'.
3. HOD reviewer records stage='hod'. Administrator can act at either stage.
4. Reject / changes_requested decisions require a mandatory comment.
5. HOD approval activates the new club, assigns the applicant as Manager, and writes an AuditLog.

get.description: Retrieve in-app notifications for the authenticated user.

put.description: Mark a specific notification as read.
Mark all unread notifications for the current user as read.

get.description: Retrieve institutional analytics calculated from actual database records (powers Power BI & Admin dashboard).
Query immutable audit log of sensitive system operations. Restricted strictly to Administrator.

post.description: Upload proposal document, club logo, or event poster to Blob Storage with MIME/size security validation.
